title: "After Class"

The session covered building a pipeline, checking it, turning it into a skill and auditing your repository. If you want to go further, this session is drawn from a longer course, **Claude Code for Accounting Research**, which goes deeper on each step and adds WRDS. It is open to any PhD student as self-study, at your own pace, and you are welcome to share it with others in your program.

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## The full course

**Site:** <https://johnmbarrios.com/claude-code-accounting/>

**Access code:** `Barrios_AI2026`

Enter the code once per browser session. Modules 1 to 5 each have a video, notes, slides, a lab and a starter pack; Module 6 is a discussion seminar.

## WRDS

We did not use WRDS today. To connect Claude Code to your own WRDS account, follow the full course's [WRDS MCP Setup page](https://johnmbarrios.com/claude-code-accounting/setup-wrds.html). It takes an hour or more, and you need a WRDS account with Duo two-factor login already working, so start early if your account is new. Module 4 then uses the connection. WRDS data is licensed to you and your institution, so keep it out of public repositories and out of anything you share.

## Skills and prompts

- The [Skills catalog](https://johnmbarrios.com/claude-code-accounting/skills/index.html) has 40 ready-made skills for accounting research, covering econometrics, data work, writing and review. Each one has a download and an install command. Read a couple of them next to your own `fsds-panel` skill and compare the descriptions.
- The [Prompts page](https://johnmbarrios.com/claude-code-accounting/prompts.html) collects the reusable prompts from the full course, including the full fourteen-year version of the six-part opening prompt, the front-loaded EDGAR prompt and the editor prompt for feedback on your writing.

## What to keep doing

Whatever tool you use next, keep doing these:

- Ask for `DATA_PROFILE.md`, `DECISIONS.md` and `LOG.md` in the first prompt, before any analysis runs.
- Check at least one number against a source the agent did not touch.
- Test a skill in a fresh session before you trust it.
- Run the two-check credential audit before you push a repository anywhere.
- Put rules that must always hold in `.claude/settings.json`, not only in CLAUDE.md.
